name: Regalboden, Pfeil hoch
description:
# Shelf levels, 70 × 32 mm paper on hand (boards of 4 cm; 2 cm boards: 18 mm tape), printed inverted (white on
# black): QR code, the code, the title and where it is; right of the code an arrow up to the shelf level above
label 70 x 32  margin 1.5 1.5 1.5 2.5  invert

  column  gap 1  align left
    row  height 38%

    text {{ location.descriptive_identifier }}  font condensed  lines 2  height 20%
